title: 공부할 때 쓰는 말: 단어, 책, 숙제, 시험
objective: By the end, you can use ten study words, such as 단어, 숙제, 시험, 질문 and 연습, in short sentences about your Korean class.
summary: Ten basic words for talking about studying Korean in and out of class.

task.title: Use the study words
task.line: Read each sentence, then choose, write, or put in order the right Korean word.

words.meaning: homework; 숙제를 하다 = to do homework
words.exampleMeaning: I haven't done my homework yet.

words.meaning: test, exam; 시험을 보다 = to take a test
words.exampleMeaning: I take a test next Friday.

words.meaning: question; 질문하다 = to ask a question

words.exampleMeaning: Please answer in a loud voice.
I practice writing Hangeul every day.

words.meaning: to be hard, difficult (어려워요 = it is hard)

exercises: Choose the right word (숙제 / 시험 / 책): 수업이 끝났어요. 이제 집에서 ____를 해요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list (단어 / 질문 / 연습): 이 ____는 처음 봐요. 뜻을 몰라요.
Write 질문 or 대답 in each blank: ① 모르는 것이 있어요. 선생님에게 ____해요. ② 선생님이 물어봤어요. 제가 ____했어요.
Choose the right verb: 오늘 오후에 영어 시험을 (봐요 / 써요).
Complete B's answer with the word for "hard": A: 한국어 시험이 어때요? B: 좀 ____.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 연습해요 / 매일 / 단어를
